summary: The candidate is valid test-only hardening for a production fix already present in the recorded base. The historical issue commit omits the distinct draft object-store metadata download, while the base and exact candidate prepare target, tokenizer, and draft URIs and deduplicate shared paths. The candidate regression and independent adversarial cases pass.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction of the original issue: only the target URI was downloaded; the distinct speculative draft URI was omitted.
The prepared base's existing model-source suite passed: 12 tests.
The exact candidate's regression suite passed: 15 tests, including distinct draft preparation, shared-path deduplication, and non-object-store exclusion.
Independent adversarial cases passed for explicit runai_streamer settings, S3/GCS/Azure schemes, uppercase scheme recognition, mixed duplicate/unique paths, and non-object-store exclusion.

tests.command: Python import-path inspection at exact candidate
tests.what_was_measured: sglang, model_path_hook, and runai_utils resolved from /job/repo/python, proving the checked-out source rather than an unrelated installed copy was exercised.

gpu_execution.evidence: The issue is a pre-worker Python URI-preparation contract and the candidate changes only Python tests/reports. The available device was one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), whereas the report used two-node NVIDIA H20 TP=8 PP=2; an unrelated GPU smoke would not validate this contract.

remaining_limitations: No object-store credentials or accessible target/draft repositories were supplied, so real S3-compatible network transfers and cache contents were not exercised.
The reported two-node NVIDIA H20 TP=8 PP=2 deployment was not available; the prepared environment has one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950).
Distributed serving, weight streaming, model execution, and semantic accuracy were outside what the deterministic pre-worker handler probe can qualify.
No native rebuild was performed because neither the candidate nor the relevant production behavior changes native code.
